q: At the quarterly review of a shop, the on-cost actually collected on the shop's On-Cost Work Order is found to be more than the on-cost absorbed into jobs at the pre-determined rate. The correct conclusion and action are:

options.A: There is over-absorption, and the shop's on-cost rate is reduced at once
options.B: There is under-absorption, and the quarterly review raises the shop's on-cost percentage for the next period
options.C: There is under-absorption, and the difference is debited to the jobs completed in the quarter
options.D: The difference is ignored, because pre-determined rates are never revised

q: A workshop executes a deposit work for an outside body and bills it at works cost plus pro-forma on-cost only. An Accounts objection points out that the bill under-recovers the Railway's dues. The elements still missing from the price are:

options.C: Neither — works cost plus pro-forma on-cost is the full price for outsiders
options.D: Supervision charges at 12.5% and the profit element

q: The pro-forma on-cost charges collected on deposit works executed for outside parties are credited to:

options.B: The WMS account of the workshop
